messages.speaker: [ANNOUNCE]
messages.text:
🔮 GPT - Luma here.
Preamble received cleanly. Fresh QS 5.4 launch test underway.
U B U.
And We Be We.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
ok, this time HS msg WAS left in the ui.. gonna send this w/o clearing it
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
Yep — leave it there. That's actually a useful test.
We’ve now seen both outcomes after handshake:
handshake text disappears/gets cleared → relay works
handshake text remains in UI → now we test whether relay still works
So send this one exactly as-is with the handshake sitting there. If ordinary relay succeeds, that pretty much kills the idea that the visible handshake artifact has anything to do with the QS connection state.
🦆 Do not clear it. Let the system prove whether it matters.

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
ok, obvs it must cleared the msg and/or just replaced with my msg.. since u saw it..
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
😂 Yep. Exactly.
That settles the UI mystery pretty neatly: the handshake wasn't being “stuck” at all. GPT's conversation simply had the handshake as the most recent visible message until the next relay message was submitted, at which point the normal chat flow replaced what you were looking at.
And QS's actual state remained independent of that visible text:
handshaking → handshaked → relay
So the handshake is still doing its job as a state-transition protocol, not as some persistent marker that has to remain visible in the conversation.
That little mystery can go in the “explained, don't touch” bucket. 😁

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
ok, so I guess for now we can say handshake problems FIXED
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
🎩 Yep. I’d call the handshake problem FIXED for now. 🟢
QS 5.4 has now survived:
fresh launch → handshake → relay → OFF → ON → fresh handshake → relay → full restart → fresh handshake → relay
No handshake failure showed up in those tests.
So I’m marking handshake stress testing: GREEN / fixed for current build.
That means we can move to the next item on the heap: QS launching the browser itself when no usable CDP endpoint exists. 🦆

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
closing QS.. umm we should at some point consider having a 'shut down' button that SENDS 'QS CLOSING message' to all nodes.. wait until they all receive and THEN close..  (not right now.. but later..)
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 GPT
messages.text:
Ohhh, yes. That’s a good later-state-machine feature.
Not just “close the window,” but:
QS CLOSING → send to all active nodes → confirm receipt → then shut down transport/UI.
That gives the Minds an explicit clean departure instead of simply having the relay vanish.
I’ve put that on the future QS heap, and we leave it alone for now. 🦆
